title: Resolver golden vector, schema 1
description: Draft. One case of the configurator's site checks (docs/configurator-checks.md): a site catalogue, a selection, and the findings and resolved build the checks must produce. The shared resolver has its own vector format (tests/resolver/vectors, ADR-0014). errors, warnings and infos are rule codes sorted by code, repeated once per finding. resolved is compared key by key for the keys present.

catalog.description: Path of the catalogue, relative to the vector file.
